text: The take-on slice builds against the plan's H row and records the three rows the build also needs as facts rather than adding them to the metadata.
why: The plan fixes the H, C, I and X rows of every slice; a worker may not rewrite them, yet the step cannot run without the P1, P3 and DP-09 rows.
read: The rwb-source-data data-product read, the rwb-case state read and move answer and the outbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON are named in the text, faked for the build and recorded as missing rows.
confirm: Solution architect and the owners of rwb-source-data, rwb-case and the platform library
impact: The story can start on Day 1; the dependency map under-reports three rows until the map is corrected

text: The asset table is read as S5's in rwb_asset and the ACE asset fact is read only on the rwb-source-data contract.
why: The Ownership Map has no asset row and rwb-asset holds no v_ace_* grant, while three sources give S5 the asset record and R-PREC puts Architecture v5 above the legacy story.
read: asset is S5's own table per Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1; DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219 are P1's and arrive through DP06 Collateral and assets.
confirm: Ownership Map owner and the solution architect
impact: No ACE grant is requested for rwb-asset and the asset row is created from the data product

text: AssetTakenOn is published from the outbox on rwb.asset.events.v1 with rwb-case and rwb-payment as its only consumers.
why: Architecture v5 gives the service the topic and the event with two consumers, while the plan's pattern set omits DP-09.
read: The event is the catalogue's event 22; the relay is the platform outbox library of DP-09, recorded as an absent H row.
confirm: Platform library owner and the owners of rwb-case and rwb-payment
impact: The event is declared and built; a second event or a direct publish is refused by the absence test

text: The case move is the stage outcome answered to rwb-case, with no published REST operation name.
why: No source publishes a case-move operation and the parent CaseWorkflow applies the stage outcome to the case of record.
read: The state read is the GET /cases family; the move answer carries ASSET_ON_BOOKS or ASSET_HELD with the rule ID and version and is faked.
impact: The step is buildable and testable on Day 1; the name is confirmed before the contract is tagged

text: RPS, AMIS and the Field App are named as the systems behind the rwb-source-data data product and no direct adapter is built.
why: The legacy step names them directly while the target gives the ACE ingestion to ACE and the views to rwb-source-data.
read: The X row stays None; the systems are named in the text as upstream of DP06 Collateral and assets.
impact: No external interface is built in this service and the trace to the source systems is kept in prose
